title: Check yourself: Citations, the Files API and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A request enables citations on one document and includes `output_config.format` with a JSON schema. What happens?

options.text: A 400 error comes back, because the features conflict
options.says: The page says "Citations and structured outputs are incompatible", and "the API returns a 400 error".

options.text: The reply is JSON with the citations inside the schema's fields
options.says: Ruled out because "citations require interleaving citation blocks with text output, which is incompatible with the strict JSON schema constraints of structured outputs."

options.text: The citations are dropped, and the schema is applied alone
options.says: Ruled out because the request does not run at all: "the API returns a 400 error".

options.text: The schema is dropped, and the citations come back alone
options.says: Ruled out because "the API returns a 400 error", so a rejected request returns no citations.

questions.stem: An application sends the id of an uploaded file straight from a web form into a Messages request. What is the risk?

options.text: Someone could read another customer's material in the same workspace
options.says: The page says "a user-supplied file ID would let one user of your application read content that another user uploaded."

options.text: The file would be deleted as soon as the request had been read
options.says: Ruled out because "Files persist until you delete them".

options.text: The request would be billed at twice the usual input price
options.says: Ruled out because "File content used in Messages requests is priced as input tokens", at the usual rate.

options.text: The file would be moved to the account of the user who sent the id
options.says: Ruled out because the page describes read access in a shared space, since files are "accessible to your entire workspace", and says nothing of moving them.

questions.stem: A citation reports a span from character 40 to character 30 in a document of 100 characters. Which problem does the practice's check name?

options.text: `unknown_document`, since the index is outside the list
options.says: Ruled out because `unknown_document` means "the document index is outside the list", and this citation names a range.

options.text: `text_mismatch`, since the cited text is not in the document
options.says: Ruled out because the checks run "in this order of checks", and the range check comes before the text comparison.

options.text: `bad_range`, since the end is not after the start
options.says: The page lists `bad_range` as "start below 0, end not after start, or end past the text".

options.text: `unsupported_type`, since the citation is not a character range
options.says: Ruled out because `unsupported_type` means "the citation is not a `char_location`", and a character range is one.
